howto.name: Paste your text
howto.text: Or type directly. Counter updates as you type.

howto.name: Read live stats
howto.text: Word count, character count (with/without spaces), sentence count, paragraph count, line count, reading time at 220 wpm.

howto.name: Optional metrics
howto.text: Average word length, longest sentence and an approximate passive-voice count.

faq.a: Whitespace-separated tokens. Hyphenated words ('self-host') count as one. Apostrophes ('don't') keep the word as one.
Word count ÷ 220 words per minute, rounded up to a whole minute. Adjust for technical content (slower) or casual reading (faster).
No — everything runs in your browser and persists only in this session.
